  PLATFORM="$INPUT_PLATFORM"

  PLATFORM="Unknown Platform"
  IFS='-' read -ra SEGMENTS <<< "$REPO_BASENAME"
  for SEGMENT in "${SEGMENTS[@]}"; do
    case "$SEGMENT" in
      iOS)      PLATFORM="iOS/iPadOS"; break ;;

  esac

# Get PR diff and changed files
gh pr diff "$PR_NUM" > pr_diff.txt || echo "No diff available" > pr_diff.txt
gh pr view "$PR_NUM" --json files --jq '.files[].path' > changed_files.txt || echo "" > changed_files.txt

# Initialize output files
touch component_names.txt cross_references.txt

# Determine file patterns based on platform
case "$PLATFORM" in
  *iOS*|*iPadOS*)
    FILE_PATTERN="\.swift$"
    SEARCH_PATTERNS="*.swift"
    EXTRACT_REGEX="(class|struct|enum|protocol) [A-Za-z0-9_]+"
    ;;
  Android)
    FILE_PATTERN="\.(kt|java)$"
    SEARCH_PATTERNS="*.kt *.java"
    EXTRACT_REGEX="(class|interface|object) [A-Za-z0-9_]+"
    ;;
  Web)
    FILE_PATTERN="\.(jsx?|tsx?)$"
    SEARCH_PATTERNS="*.js *.jsx *.ts *.tsx"
    EXTRACT_REGEX="(export )?(function|const|class) [A-Za-z0-9_]+"
    ;;
  *)
    FILE_PATTERN=""
    ;;
esac

# Extract component names and cross-references if we have a pattern
if [ -n "$FILE_PATTERN" ]; then
  for file in $(grep -E "$FILE_PATTERN" changed_files.txt 2>/dev/null); do
    if [ -f "$file" ]; then
      grep -oE "$EXTRACT_REGEX" "$file" | awk '{print $NF}' >> component_names.txt 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  done

  # Find cross-references for each component
  if [ -s component_names.txt ]; then
    sort -u component_names.txt -o component_names.txt
    while read -r component; do
      [ -z "$component" ] && continue
      echo "=== Usage of $component ===" >> cross_references.txt
      # shellcheck disable=SC2086
      git grep -l "$component" -- $SEARCH_PATTERNS 2>/dev/null | head -20 >> cross_references.txt || true
      echo "" >> cross_references.txt
    done < component_names.txt
  fi
fi

# Truncate diff to avoid token limits
head -c 8000 pr_diff.txt > pr_diff_truncated.txt
mv pr_diff_truncated.txt pr_diff.txt

# Cap cross-references to avoid token limits
if [ -s cross_references.txt ]; then
  head -c 4000 cross_references.txt > cross_references_capped.txt
  mv cross_references_capped.txt cross_references.txt
fi
